notes.zh-CN:
修复关闭后仍打开旧版本：下载完成并退出后，会等进程结束再静默安装；支持断点续传。
统一 Windows 与 Mac 更新记录和清单；Mac 最低支持 macOS 13.4，修复界面显示。
Mac build 116：优化顶栏更新按钮、启动检查与关闭后安装重启，更新开关重启后生效。
notes.en-US:
Fix: quit waits for WePic to exit before silent install so the next launch is new. Downloads can resume after restart.
Shared Windows/Mac update manifest and history; macOS 13.4+ support and UI fixes.
Mac build 116: refine the titlebar action, startup checks, install/relaunch and persisted update controls.

zh-CN.title: 修复
items: 下载完成后关闭再打开仍是旧版本：现已等进程完全退出后再静默安装
安装包下载中断后可续传，不必从头下

zh-CN.title: Mac 与跨平台更新
items: Windows 与 Mac 共用更新清单与完整更新记录，不再单独维护 Mac JSON。
Mac 支持发布者签名校验、下载后安装与重启，失败时保留恢复信息。
Apple Silicon 安装包最低支持 macOS 13.4，包含本地文字识别和图片解码依赖。
修复设置复选框裁切、首页按钮边框及浅色主题显示问题。

zh-CN.title: Mac 更新体验（build 116）
items: 启动时检查新版本，不再被上次检查的时间间隔跳过。
下载完成后关闭或退出，可安装并自动重新打开新版本。
顶栏更新入口改为低调的小按钮，悬停高亮并显示关闭按钮，可在设置中恢复。
修复浅色主题文字与更新开关；开关即时保存，重启后保持生效。

en-US.title: Fixes
items: After a finished download, quitting no longer left you on the old build—install waits until WePic has fully exited
Interrupted installer downloads resume instead of starting over

en-US.title: Mac and shared updates
items: Windows and Mac use one version.json and the same complete release history.
Mac updates verify publisher signatures before download/install and retain recovery information on failure.
Apple Silicon packages target macOS 13.4+ and include local OCR and image decoders.
Fix clipped settings checkboxes, welcome button borders and light-theme rendering.

en-US.title: Mac update experience (build 116)
items: Check once at startup even when the previous session checked recently.
Install a verified update when closing or quitting, then reopen the new app.
Compact neutral titlebar action, highlighted on hover with a dismiss control; restore it in Settings.
Improve light-theme readability and persist update preferences across restarts.

zh-CN.title: 功能
items: 更新下载完成后不再打断使用；关闭后会静默安装，下次打开即为新版本
AI 翻译可选择目标语言：中文、英文，或跟随界面语言

zh-CN.title: 改进
items: 界面中英文切换更完整
浅色主题下更新记录文字更清晰
设置与图片信息等窗口体验优化

en-US.title: Features
items: Updates download in the background without interrupting you; they install when you quit, and the next launch uses the new version
Choose AI translation target: Chinese, English, or follow the UI language

en-US.title: Improvements
items: More complete Chinese / English UI coverage
Clearer update-history text in light theme
Smoother Settings and image-information dialogs

zh-CN.title: 功能
items: 启动后可自动检查更新，并在后台下载
下载完成后可自动安装并重新打开 WePic
设置 → 关于 可随时查看更新记录

zh-CN.title: 改进
items: 更新窗口外观与设置界面一致
更新说明改成更通俗的表述，方便了解改了什么

en-US.title: Features
items: Auto-check for updates after launch, with background download
When ready, install and reopen WePic automatically
Open update history anytime from Settings → About

en-US.title: Improvements
items: Update window looks consistent with Settings
Release notes rewritten in plain language
